trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is open as INC-0002 and on-call has been paged.

- **The problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **The rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. No change-manager approval was needed because it had been healthy there before. After the rollback all three regions are on v2.3.0 and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **The incident:** It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovered numbers. My first attempt to create it timed out. The incident list was still empty afterwards, so I tried again, and there's only one incident and one page.

The release candidate for v2.3.1 was already unhealthy in staging but still went to production. I added that to the incident as a follow-up, along with finding out why v2.3.1 failed.
